thesis: Mario Terrian evaluates Systematica Investments based on three key attributes of founder Leda Braga—brains, humility, and authenticity—along with the technical integrity and pedigree of her quantitative team. The selection process involves a rigorous validation of the firm's investment process, specifically how they handle data cleaning, model validation, and team dynamics, rather than relying solely on a mechanical checklist or track record.
